defs.def: an idea, a feeling or an opinion that you get about sb/sth, or that sb/sth gives you 印象；感想

ex.s: He wasn't mean or abusive; he just gave me the impression he could do whatever project we dreamed up better if he did it alone.
ex.t: 他并不刻薄或恶毒；他给我的印象是无论我们想出什么项目，他自己做都会更好。

ex.s: First impression cannot always be trusted．
ex.t: 第一印象不能总是被信任．

ex.s: A few characters are used to create a single impression growing out of the theme.
ex.t: 我的意图不是指出这本集子中每部剧本的中心主题，因为这确实会破坏阅读、讨论和思考这些剧作的乐趣以及剧作家的效果。
7.（1分）我们可以观察到人工智能已经在许多方面对我们的生活产生了影响．（  ）

defs.def: the effect that an experience or a person has on sb/sth 影响；效果
a drawing showing what a person looks like or what a place or a building will look like in the future 印象画

ex.s: If you ever get the impression that your dog can "tell" whether you look content or annoyed, you may be onto something.
ex.t: 在训练阶段每只狗只能看到人脸的上半部分或下半部分。

defs.def: an amusing copy of the way a person acts or speaks （对某人举止言谈的）滑稽模仿
an appearance that may be false （虚假的）外观；假象
a mark that is left when an object is pressed hard into a surface 压痕

ex.s: Antarctica left an impression on me that no other place has,” Ginni says.
ex.t: 南极洲给我留下了其他任何地方都没有的印象，"Ginni说。

defs.def: all the copies of a book that are printed at one time, with few or no changes to the contents since the last time the book was printed 重印本；印次

ex.s: What I say to make a good first impression?
ex.t: 我该说什么来留下好的第一印象？

ex.s: An opinion can be a general or individual view, belief or impression.
ex.t: 一个观点可以是一般或个人的看法、信念或印象。

ex.s: Why did it make such an impression on you?
ex.t: 它为什么给你留下如此深刻的印象？

ex.s: In this part adapted from a chapter of the book, Aronnax describes the experience of walking on the sea bed… 1 And now, how can I look back upon the impression left upon me by that walk under the waters?
ex.t: 在这一部分改编自书中一章的内容中，阿龙纳斯描述了在海底行走的经历……现在，我该如何回顾那次水下行走给我留下的印象呢？

ex.s: We were walking on fine, even sand, not wrinkled, as on a flat shore, which keeps the impression of the waves.
ex.t: 我们走在细密平整的沙上，没有褶皱，像平坦的海岸一样，保留着波浪的印记。
